card.name: Adverb slot before a verb or adjective
card.fires_on: Small words in the middle of a clause where an adverb or modifier could come next, such as "as", "also", "sometimes", "not", "can". The setting is plain explanatory prose.

modes.label: Linking or adverb word
modes.description: An adverb or linker sits between a subject and its verb phrase.
modes.example: Sotos syndrome is also<< sometimes>> called cerebral gigantism.

modes.label: Auxiliary or negation
modes.description: A verb helper or "not" follows the subject, before the main predicate.
modes.example: Bipolar disorder is<< not>> easy to spot when it starts.

modes.label: Comparison or role word
modes.description: Words like "as" or "than" that start a comparison or role phrase.
modes.example: information regarding the treatment of overdosage may change more rapidly<< than>> the package insert.
